name: io.github.nkapila6/mcpsurfr
title: mcpsurfr
description: Local web search with multi-engine deep research and on-device re-ranking. No API keys.

environmentVariables.name: MCPSURFR_MAX_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Text budget per call for the full-page tools, shared across pages (~4 chars per token).

environmentVariables.name: MCPSURFR_DEEP_RESEARCH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: What deep_research returns when a call doesn't say: full pages, or only the passages that answer each term (about a tenth of the tokens).

environmentVariables.name: MCPSURFR_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds searches and fetched pages are reused. 0 turns the cache off.
